Elder_Otaku's 1920 x 1080 Wallpaper Maker (Kohya Variation) v1.0.0

This workflow was designed with SDXL checkpoints in mind. It was tested thoroughly with Gleipnir v2.0 BF16, which can be found here: https://civitai.com/models/175094/gleipnir
as well as MOWAWK v1.8, which can be found here: https://civitai.com/models/144952/mohawk

The "Switch (Any)"- node underneath can be used to change the subject.
If the switch is put to 1 it will create female celebrity wallpapers.
If the switch is put to 2 it will be male celebrities instead.

If the switch is put to 3, 4 or 5 the "Face Fix"-group should be bypassed.

If the switch is put to 3 it will generate abstract wallpapers.
If the switch is put to 4 it will generate animals.
If the switch is put to 5 it will generate landscapes.
